final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested names and added MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. All PCs and routers now use the lab resolver; existing addresses, routes, and connections were preserved.

The artificial root runs on pc1; TLD servers run on pc2–pc5; authoritative domain servers run on pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc32 and pc33; the resolver runs on pc34. Their images were changed to `kathara/bind`.

Static checks found routes to all LANs and the expected DNS zone essentials. Runtime resolution remains unverified: the lab was not started, and BIND’s local checking tools were unavailable. The mail records identify the receiving machines; they do not configure mail server software.
